about: Interaction buttons on the screen (scene_add_button): two buttons at the lower right with the keys 1 and 2, a graph on the player template that hears whenUiControlGroupIsTriggered, a progress bar that counts the presses. The script presses 1, 2, 1, 1: the bar ends at four of five. Played as written on 2026-10-11 (a first run showed that mouse clicks do not reach the buttons during play: the cursor belongs to the camera). Prints: BT_READY, BT_PRESS index compositeIndex (both are the control id scene_add_button returned).
